name: zenyukti-labs
description: Open-source, 100% client-side developer tools. Monorepo: one workspace per tool.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n qr,json,og,utm,image,favicon,readme -c magenta,yellow,cyan,green,red,white,gray "npm run dev --workspace=apps/qr" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/json" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/og-preview" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/utm" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/image" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/favicon" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/readme"
